Third-party code used by the Read aloud tab, copied as published (browser builds):

| File | Package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `marked.umd.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 18.1.3 | MIT |
| `purify.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.4.17 | MPL-2.0 or Apache-2.0 |

To update: copy the same files from a newer `marked` (`lib/marked.umd.js`) and `dompurify` (`dist/purify.js`).
